correctness.rationale: The supplied standalone exhaustive Python 3 program independently verifies Fano incidence and the 24 perfect matchings by permanent DP and recursion, all 2,201 faces and f-vector, 1,092 distinct matched face-cover pairs, 17 critical faces in dimensions 0 and 2, and directed acyclicity by a complete topological sort of all 8,736 face incidences. By Forman discrete Morse theory, these critical dimensions make the homotopy type a wedge of sixteen S^2. Mod-two boundary ranks independently corroborate but are not used to infer integral homotopy.

value.rationale: The projective-plane incidence (Heawood) graph is a canonical unique smallest cubic girth-six graph with 24 1-factors. Its extendible-matching simplicial complex is naturally motivated by literature on perfect-matching complexes of other bipartite graphs. The exact integral homotopy type is not implied by its known ordinary matching-complex homotopy or perfect-matching count, and provides a meaningful distinction between two canonical graph complexes rather than a numerical routine increment.
